title: ASTEROID DASH
oneLiner: Pilot through a storm of tumbling asteroids and blast a path to the high score.
mechanics: Your ship rotates and thrusts through a single-screen asteroid field.
Press A to fire lasers; large asteroids split into smaller, faster rocks.
Destroying asteroids scores points, with smaller fragments worth more.
The field grows denser and faster as your score rises.

controls.b: Hypershift briefly to a random safe spot

lose: Lose all three ships by colliding with an asteroid.
scoring: Score points for destroying asteroids, earning more for smaller fragments.
